articles.text: MÈIMEI: Èrjiě, nǐ kàn shénme bào ne?
YOUNGER SISTER: What newspaper are you reading, Sister Number Two?
ÈRJIĚ: Míng Bào, wǒ xǐhuan zhèige bàozhǐ, bú zuǒ yě bú yòu.
SECOND SISTER: Ming Pao. I like it; it's neither too left nor too right.
MÈIMEI: Érqiě, shìjièxìngde xīnwén tā dōu yǒu. Zhèige bào zhēnde bú cuò.
YOUNGER SISTER: And it has all the world news. It's really quite a good paper.
ÈRJIĚ: Wǒ yě xǐhuan tāde guǎnggào, duì wǒmen zhèixie zhù zài guówàide Zhōngguo rén hěn yǒu yòng.
SECOND SISTER: I like its advertisements too. They are very useful to us Chinese who live abroad.
MÈIMEI: Nǐ kànjian shénme guǎnggào le, zhème yǒu xìngqù?
YOUNGER SISTER: What ad did you see that you're so interested in?
ÈRJIĚ: Nǐ lái kàn, zhèr yǒu yíge diànshì guǎnggào.
SECOND SISTER: Come look, there's an ad for a television here.
MÈIMEI: Zěnme shuōde?
YOUNGER SISTER: What does it say?
ÈRJIĚ: Zhèige guǎnggào shuō, zhǐ yào wǒmen jì yìzhāng zhīpiào dào Xiānggǎng, jiù kěyi gěi jiāli rén mǎi cǎisè diànshì le.
SECOND SISTER: It says that if we just send a check to Hong Kong, we can buy a color television for our family.
MÈIMEI: Shì ma? Dàlù rén mǎi diànshì bù róngyi. Wǒmen lái kànkan, kàn néng bu néng gěi yéye nǎinai mǎi ge diànshì.
YOUNGER SISTER: Oh? It's not easy for people on the mainland to buy televisions. Let's look and see if we can buy a T.V. for grandpa and grandma.
ÈRJIĚ: Bànfǎ shi zhèiyàngr: Wǒmen bǎ qián hé yéyede dìzhǐ jì dào Xiānggǎng, Xiānggǎngde gōngsī jì yìzhāng dānzi gěi tāmen, tāmen jiù kěyi zài Guǎngzhōude bǎihuò gōngsī qǔ diànshì le.

SECOND SISTER: This is the way it works: We send the money and grandpa's address to Hong Kong, and the company in Hong Kong sends them a receipt, and then they can pick up the television at a department store in Guǎngzhōu.
MÈIMEI: Rúguǒ nèige diànshì bù hǎo zěnme bàn?
YOUNGER SISTER: What if the television has something wrong with it?
ÈRJIĚ: Nà shi gōngsīde zérèn, tāmen yídìng kěyi gěi huàn yíge hǎode.
SECOND SISTER: That's the company's responsibility. I'm sure they would exchange it for a good one.
MÈIMEI: M, nà bú cuò, xiànzài yéye nǎinai shēnghuó āndìng, shénme dōu hǎo, jiù shi shǎo yíge diànshì. Yǒule diànshì, tāmen yídìng hěn gāoxìng.

YOUNGER SISTER: Mm, that's good. Now grandpa and grandma have a settled life, and all is well for them; the only thing they lack is a television. When they have a television I'm sure they'll be very happy.
ÈRJIĚ: Duì, wǒmen jīntian jiù bǎ zhīpiào jìchuqu.
SECOND SISTER: Right. Let's send out the check today.
